messages.author: b515ec07b86c3049
messages.subject: Pystan compile error with multi_normal
parts:
Hi,

I'm a new user to Stan and I'm mainly using pystan. Could anyone help me with the compile error with the model code below, as I've been having issues with using multi_normal distribution. The model code:

data{
    int<lower=0> N;
    matrix[N,N] sigma;
    vector[N] y;
}
parameters{
    vector[N] mu;
}
model{
    for (i in 1:N)
        mu[i] ~ normal(0.0, 1.0);

    y ~ multi_normal(mu, sigma);
}

The full error message is attached. I've tried to compile the same code in rstan and it works so I guess this problem is just associated with pystan...I'm using the latest rstan, pystan 2.11.0.0 on Win7 OS with python 3.5. Any help would be greatly appreciated.

Best,
Chaoxie

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] Pystan compile error with multi_normal
parts:
That should compile. Do you know which C++ compiler you're
using?

Also, you can replace that first loop with just

mu ~ normal(0, 1);

It'll be more efficient.

I'd also suggest declaring sigma as a cov_matrix[N], which will
make sure it's symmetric and positive definite at data-load
time.

I take it this is just a toy model as there is only a single
observation y.

- Bob
